$description: Theme overrides for component tokens — only for decisions that genuinely differ between light and dark. Anything identical in both themes belongs in src/tokens/component/.

background.$description: The light outline fill: a clean surface-default sheet, so the button still reads as a button on the canvas, a sunken panel, a sidebar or a toolbar — not only on a white card.

thumb.$description: The off thumb: a light disc on the control-grey track (≥3.6:1). It inverts to the graphite thumb-checked when on, so the state reads by lightness and position, not by hue.

background.$description: The light writing surface: a clean surface-default sheet, so a field still reads as a field on the canvas, a sunken panel, a sidebar or a toolbar — not only on a white card.
